g.text: Rendered evidence from captured output
Observed at +0.3171372413635254s — page 1
21-Every logical run needs an online start response. MCPJam retries transient failures within ten seconds, then stops before execu
tion. A prior successful run does not enable offline execution. The CLI resolves the project using its existing `--project`, envir
onment, and linked-project settings; a key can only access its own organization.
23:With results uploads disabled, the start-run request sends only the credential in the authorization header, any MCPJam API head
ers you configure through the SDK's `inference.resolveMcpjam`, project selection, a new run-start ID, client version and surface (
SDK, CLI, or Vitest), planned iteration count, provider names, and whether a client profile is used (`unknown` for custom executor
s). The server resolves the organization and account. The start-run request sends no prompts, outputs, tool calls, or server URLs.
MCPJam-hosted inference still sends prompts through MCPJam to the model, as before. Retries reuse the same ID. Planned iterations
are intent, not completed usage or a charge. This release adds no debit, quota draw, or balance refusal.
25-`DO_NOT_TRACK`, `MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED`, and CLI telemetry settings disable analytics, not the required run-start request.
Results remain local unless result uploading is enabled separately.
133-| `byok` | `provider/model` | BYOK; the provider key is required |
134-| `mcpjam` | `provider/model` | MCPJam; the model must be one MCPJam serves |
136:There is no fallback: a key the provider rejects is a credential failure (exit `3`), never a reason to spend platform credits
instead.
138-BYOK keys are read from the standard variables: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY` (or `GEM
INI_API_KEY`), `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, `MISTRAL_API_KEY`, `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, `XAI_API_KEY`. `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`, `OPENAI_BASE_URL`
and `OLLAMA_BASE_URL` point a provider at a gateway or proxy.
191-| An advisory judge (including the hosted default) | Not run; the report says so |
192-| `suppressedSuiteStandardCheckIds` | Refused — a local run has no suite-standard registry |
194:Every selected case is checked before any model or tool call, so an unsupported later case costs nothing. Hosted-only capabili
ties run with `mcpjam cloud eval run --file <file>`.
196-## Output
